projecthero.guide.beast_boy.diet.body: Gar has been every animal there is, so he won't eat one. As Beast Boy you can't eat meat or fish of any kind, raw or cooked, in any form (human too): beef, pork, chicken, mutton, rabbit, rabbit stew, cod, salmon, tropical fish, pufferfish, rotten flesh, spider eyes, and meat or fish from other mods. Bread, fruit, vegetables, mushroom and beetroot stew, cake and golden apples are all fine.
